pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Zakat? (1 mark)
   A. Use Administration of Zakat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Zakat.
   C. Say Administration of Zakat has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Funeral Rites? (1 mark)
   A. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Funeral Rites has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Funeral Rites.
   D. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.
   C. Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)
   A. Use Types of Divorce to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Types of Divorce has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Asbabu al- nuzuul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.
   C. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an.
   D. Say Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

12. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.
   D. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Labour Relations in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Ethics of Da’wa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Foods and Drinks [Carrion Blood Pork animals dedicated to other than Allah ] and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: Islamic clothing and adornment 3.3 Virtues: manners of walking 3.4 Virt and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. D — Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

12. D — Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Labour Relations in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Ethics of Da’wa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Foods and Drinks [Carrion Blood Pork animals dedicated to other than Allah ]; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues: Islamic clothing and adornment 3.3 Virtues: manners of walking 3.4 Virt; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
